title: 白鶴灘水壩
summary: 白鶴灘案例連結柱狀節理岩體、低熱混凝土與大型水輪發電機，從局部剛度及熱量一路推到轉矩、視在功率、冷卻和調速介面。課程刻意分開實際裝機規模與假想材料參數，並要求學員對每個簡化模型提出可驗證觀察及升級分析條件。
summaryEn: The Baihetan case connects jointed rock, low-heat concrete and large turbine-generators, moving from local stiffness and thermal energy to torque, apparent power, cooling and governor interfaces. Actual installed scale is separated from assumed material parameters. Each simplified model requires an observable verification method and a stated condition for more advanced analysis.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」及「巨型機組軸轉矩」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m；第二組為 binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Columnar joint series compliance, then compare the controlling variables in Low heat cement adiabatic rise and Gigawatt unit shaft torque. The first calculation is kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m; the second is binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「柱狀節理串聯柔度」與「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Columnar joint series compliance" and "Low heat cement adiabatic rise": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱狀節理串聯柔度」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Columnar joint series compliance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。當載重路徑依序通過岩塊及節理，兩者變形可在簡化一維模型中相加，等效剛度由柔度相加求得。這種尺度分析幫助理解很薄的弱介面為何可能主導整體變形，但不代表真實三維節理網絡。 串聯元件承受相同力，平行元件則共享位移，先確認物理連接才能決定應加剛度還是加柔度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱狀節理串聯柔度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip. A load path passing sequentially through rock and an interface permits additive displacements in a simplified one-dimensional model, with compliances added to obtain equivalent stiffness. A thin weak interface can dominate deformation, though the model does not represent a three-dimensional joint network. Elements in series carry equal force, whereas parallel elements share displacement; the physical connection determines whether stiffnesses or compliances should be added in the model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Columnar joint series compliance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Columnar joint series compliance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Columnar joint series compliance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m。模型邊界：單一串聯線彈性載重路徑，兩元件同力且不滑移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m. Model boundary: one linear elastic series path with equal force in both elements and no sliding. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用不同載重級的現地位移檢查線性與回復性，分別量測岩塊內與跨節理的變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check linearity and recovery over several field load levels, measuring within blocks and across joints separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柱狀節理串聯柔度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Columnar joint series compliance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用不同載重級的現地位移檢查線性與回復性，分別量測岩塊內與跨節理的變形。若主要變形集中在界面，應優先辨認節理閉合；若卸載後殘留位移大，串聯彈簧需改為非線性接觸模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check linearity and recovery over several field load levels, measuring within blocks and across joints separately. Interface-dominated movement points toward joint closure, while substantial residual movement after unloading requires nonlinear contact behavior rather than two purely elastic series springs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將節理剛度提高一倍重算等效剛度，再比較只提高岩塊剛度的效果，指出試驗與處理資源應優先釐清哪一個變形來源。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double joint stiffness and recompute the equivalent value, then compare doubling only block stiffness. Identify which deformation source should receive priority in testing and in evaluating a proposed treatment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「柱狀節理串聯柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Columnar joint series compliance"?

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Columnar joint series compliance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. Opening or sliding can change the path itself, so one reduced constant stiffness cannot describe every loading stage and contact condition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：串聯元件承受相同力，平行元件則共享位移，先確認物理連接才能決定應加剛度還是加柔度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Elements in series carry equal force, whereas parallel elements share displacement; the physical connection determines whether stiffnesses or compliances should be added in the model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。
knowledge.textEn: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. Opening or sliding can change the path itself, so one reduced constant stiffness cannot describe every loading stage and contact condition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱狀節理串聯柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Columnar joint series compliance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。
使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness.

steps.instruction: 低熱水泥減少或延緩水化放熱，但大體積混凝土仍可能累積顯著溫升。教材以膠結料用量乘單位放熱量，再除混凝土體積熱容量估算絕熱上升尺度。放熱隨齡期改變，骨材與摻料也影響熱容量，因此材料名稱本身不能替代實測溫升曲線。 單位膠結料放熱量必須附齡期，早期與最終放熱不能混用，否則低熱材料延遲放熱的特徵會被抹平。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low-heat cement reduces or delays hydration heat, but mass concrete can still accumulate a substantial temperature rise. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K。模型邊界：假定指定齡期放熱全被保留的絕熱估算，不含散熱及水化動力學。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 對實際配比做絕熱或半絕熱試驗，核對試件齡期、初溫與摻料比例，再與現場核心溫度及冷卻帳比較。若現場峰值較低，應查散熱與放熱時間，而非直接宣稱水泥單位放熱量不同。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 巨型機組軸轉矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gigawatt unit shaft torque: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「巨型機組軸轉矩」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gigawatt unit shaft torque” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 百萬千瓦級機組的低速軸系需傳遞很大的轉矩，機械功率與電端功率要先分清楚。教材把指定軸功率除以角速度，得到平均扭矩，再討論法蘭、軸承與轉輪連接的載重路徑。平均扭矩不能表示扭振峰值，也不能由單機容量推論材料應力。 若功率以兆瓦輸入而角速度以每秒計，所得扭矩自然是兆牛頓米，但弧度的無因次慣例仍需說明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「巨型機組軸轉矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A low-speed gigawatt-class shaft transmits large torque, and mechanical power must be distinguished from terminal electrical power. Divide specified shaft power by angular speed for mean torque, then trace loads through flanges, bearings and runner connections. Mean torque does not describe torsional peaks or determine material stress from unit capacity alone. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Independent measurement weighted estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。若兩者一起偏移但差值不變，需要外部基準；加權平均無法從兩份共同錯誤中恢復真值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

If both drift together while their difference remains constant, an external reference is required; weighted averaging cannot recover truth from two observations with the same bias. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add the same bias to both observations, recompute the fused estimate and check whether their difference changes. Propose a third independent observation and reference arrangement capable of exposing the shared drift.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
